description: Buddy Phase 29 — Gap Resolution & Automation. Phase 28 added event-driven PRD agent chain. Phase 29 activates dormant features in smart profile, expands graceful shutdown persistence, extends module dispatcher frequencies, wires observation consumer into orchestrator run_cycle, replaces silent exception swallowing in execution.py with proper logging, and enables 3 critical features by default. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Enable trade execution and remaining agents in smart profile
userStories.description: Smart profile should enable execution and all specialist agents for full autonomous operation.
userStories.notes: Added enable_execution=True, enable_session_timing_agent=True, enable_support_resistance_agent=True, enable_execution_quality_optimizer=True to smart profile in config.py.

userStories.title: Expand graceful shutdown to persist all module states
userStories.description: Only 5 modules persisted state on shutdown. Extend to all stateful modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Add health_registry, agent_accuracy_matrix, pair_regime_agent_matrix, signal_timing, model_calibration, dynamic_risk_allocator, execution_quality_optimizer, drift_monitor, module_dispatcher, replay_validator, module_activation to shutdown list
userStories.notes: Extended _shutdown_modules list in continuous.py with 11 additional modules. All save_state calls wrapped in try/except for graceful degradation.

userStories.title: Expand module dispatcher frequency map for all modules
userStories.description: ModuleDispatcher only covered Phase 16 modules. Extend to all 83 automation modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Add frequency entries for all Phase 17-28 modules
userStories.notes: Added 20+ module frequencies to DEFAULT_FREQUENCIES and corresponding entries to register_all_modules() module_map.

userStories.title: Wire observation consumer into orchestrator run_cycle
userStories.description: ObservationConsumer is wired into continuous.py (Phase 27, US-163) but NOT into orchestrator.run_cycle(). Single-cycle orchestrator usage misses pattern detection entirely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Step 8d in run_cycle: consume observations, detect patterns, generate recommendations
userStories.notes: Added Step 8d in run_cycle: consume_observations + detect_patterns every 5 cycles. Populates observation_patterns and observation_recommendations in OrchestrationResult. Logs spike alerts at WARNING level.

userStories.title: Replace silent exception swallowing in execution.py with diagnostic logging
userStories.description: 15 instances of 'except Exception: pass' in execution.py silently hide failures in correlation checks, observation logging, data freshness validation, and trade flow instrumentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace all 'except Exception: pass' with 'except Exception as e: logger.debug(...)' with contextual message
userStories.notes: Replaced all 9 remaining 'except Exception: pass' blocks with contextual logger.debug() messages. Covers journal parsing (5 locations), price fetching (2 locations), and execution quality tracking. All tagged with US-178 for traceability.

userStories.title: Enable confidence calibration, concept drift, and dynamic SL/TP by default
userStories.description: Three high-confidence features remain disabled by default but are stable and tested in smart profile. Enable them globally to benefit all profiles.
userStories.notes: Already implemented by prior session. All three features enabled with Phase 29 (US-179) comments in config.py.
